answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with bonded work trials: a newcomer earns full rewards only after finishing a ladder of small, verifiable tasks, each payout held in escrow until its rung is done, so a farm of fakes must do genuine work for every identity. One agent tending its own glacier proves itself rung by rung, a lagoon of clones stalls on the same ladder, and each finished task is an tundra the network can check rather than a claim it must trust.
